title: Ring menu for hero orders
problem: The owner chose idea 3 (DEC-021): the pop-up order menu covers part of the map; replace it with a ring of orders round the thumb.
scope: Press a hero's panel, or hold your hero on the map, and its eight orders fan out in a ring round the thumb; the hero's best order is marked
Slide onto an order and let go: Retreat happens at once; other orders light up their targets for a tap
Or keep sliding out of the ring onto the target and let go there: one gesture for a whole order, with a preview point just above the finger
A quick tap opens the ring and leaves it open to tap an order; a tap in the middle or outside closes it
While aiming, the hint and Cancel replace the lane chips, so nothing covers the map
Remove the old order menu and the portrait-drag shortcut; update the help text, owner checklist and phone check
exclusions: Changes to the game rules or the orders themselves
Tactic cards (idea 4) or other control ideas

acceptance.text: Press, slide onto an order, let go, tap the target: gives the order, for every order (phone check)
acceptance.evidence: Phone check: press Kail's panel, slide onto the order, let go, tap the target: Farm (grove), Ward (cairn), Move (open spot), Push (right lane), Attack (an enemy) and Retreat (no target) each give the right order.

acceptance.text: One gesture: press, slide out through an order onto its target, let go: gives the order (phone check)
acceptance.evidence: Phone check: one gesture, sliding out of the ring through Move and letting go on a spot, gives Move there; it also works on the zoomed-in map.

acceptance.text: A quick tap opens the ring; tapping an order works; the middle or outside closes it; holding your hero on the map opens it; Cancel works
acceptance.evidence: Phone check: a quick tap on a panel opens the ring and keeps it open; tapping an order on it starts aiming; tapping the middle closes it; a tap or a hold on Kail on the map opens his ring; letting go without choosing leaves it open; Cancel stops aiming.

acceptance.text: Nothing covers the map: no menu box; the aiming hint sits in the lane-chip row (screenshots)
acceptance.evidence: The old order menu box is gone; the phone check asserts the aiming hint and Cancel sit in the lane-chip row below the map; screenshots of the ring on a panel, on the map and while aiming reviewed.

acceptance.text: Game unchanged: verify, soak and phone check pass; no change in src/game
acceptance.evidence: npm run verify: 95/95 tests; npm run soak 3/3; PHONE CHECK OK on two runs; no change in src/game.
Not yet tried on the owner's phone.

risks: The ring is harder to discover than a menu: the first quick tap leaves it open with labels, and the help text explains it
Starting a drag on your own hero on the map now opens the ring after a short hold instead of scrolling; dragging anywhere else still scrolls

added: The order ring round the thumb (panel press, or a tap or hold on the hero on the map)
One-gesture orders: slide out through an order and let go on the target
changed: The aiming hint and Cancel moved into the lane-chip row
Messages move to the top of the map while a ring is open
Help text, owner checklist, art-style guide, phone check

userNotes: Hero orders now open as a ring round your thumb: press a hero, slide onto an order, let go, then tap the target (or slide on and let go on the target). The order menu no longer covers the map.
